title: chrysanthemum reboudianum
intro: Chrysanthemum reboudianum, commonly known as White Chrysanthemum, is a type of flowering plant that belongs to the Asteraceae family. The health benefits of White Chrysanthemum include its ability to lower cholesterol levels, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antioxidant properties. Its therapeutic actions include sedative, antipyretic, and anti-inflammatory effects, making it useful in treating anxiety, fever, and skin conditions. The bioactive constituents of White Chrysanthemum include flavonoids, saponins, and triterpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
